seeking quashing of the impugned order dated 21st August, 2024 passed by the Sales Tax Officer Class II/Avato Ward 94, Zone-8, Delhi for the Financial Year 2019-20 .

events.quote: On facts, however, the GST registration of the Petitioner was cancelled on account of closure of the business of the Petitioner vide application dated 9th March, 2024 bearing ARN AA070324018424K.
Thereafter, a Show Cause Notice dated 24th May, 2024 (hereinafter, ‘SCN’) was issued to the Petitioner.
Moreover, a reminder was also issued to the Petitioner on 4th July, 2024, however, the same could also not be accessed by the Petitioner.

defects_argued.quote: However, it is made clear that the issue in respect of the validity of the impugned notifications is left open.
Ld. Counsel for the Petitioner further submits that the Petitioner could not access the GST Portal as the GST registration of the Petitioner was cancelled vide application dated 9th March, 2024.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside.
